General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging

What is This Part?
This cap fits on the top of the dash on both the left and right of the steering wheel
This is the SMALL Dash Cap that covers the dash attachment screws.
This cover will only fit the dashes that have the round air vents (1986 – 1988).
Color: Gray
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Dash Cap
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1986 – 1988 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1986 – 1988 All Models
